detailed_descriptions.en: Set out along the northern lines of the Łódź region with the Łódź North Region DLC ! This add-on brings you 140 km of new routes , connecting charming single-track local lines with powerful junction stations. Two new single-track routes offer varied and demanding gameplay: from the Kutno junction through picturesque Witonia and historic Łęczyca all the way to Zgierz , the official gateway to the Łódź Railway Junction , and onwards to Łowicz , where small stations with just a single passing track become a true test of traffic planning. Take control: as a dispatcher, you decide which train to let through and which to hold, while as a driver you must stick precisely to the timetable. Remember that a single delay can block an oncoming train and cause disruptions to cascade across the entire line. detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Set out along the northern lines of the Łódź region with the Łódź North Region DLC!

This add-on brings you 140 km of new routes, connecting charming single-track local lines with powerful junction stations. Two new single-track routes offer varied and demanding gameplay: from the Kutno junction through picturesque Witonia and historic Łęczyca all the way to Zgierz, the official gateway to the Łódź Railway Junction, and onwards to Łowicz, where small stations with just a single passing track become a true test of traffic planning.

Take control: as a dispatcher, you decide which train to let through and which to hold, while as a driver you must stick precisely to the timetable. Remember that a single delay can block an oncoming train and cause disruptions to cascade across the entire line.

Key features:

  • 140 km of new, faithfully recreated routes

  • Two distinct single-track routes: Kutno - Zgierz and Zgierz - Łowicz

  • Junction stations Kutno, Zgierz and Łowicz with connecting lines for smooth maneuvers

  • Atmospheric stops and historic station buildings, including Witonia, Łęczyca, Ozorków and Grotniki

  • Demanding traffic management at passing loops under the pressure of the timetable

  • The double-track Łowicz - Skierniewice main line

  • Singleplayer and multiplayer gameplay, in the driver's cab or at the dispatcher's panel

  • Fully compatible with existing SimRail rolling stock and DLC

  • Connection to existing routes around Łódź and the line to Warsaw

Drive heavy freight trains, passenger services or expresses, or take a seat at the signal box and test your skills managing traffic on single-track lines in SimRail - The Railway Simulator!
